checks.summary: A font the document uses is unavailable or substituted, so the rendering may differ from the author's.
The product engine exposes no font diagnostics, so the fonts the document uses were not checked.
An opaque foreground shape covers at least 30% of a chart.
A slide holds so many content objects or so much text that it may be hard to read.
Several content objects with little text occupy only a small part of a slide.
A slide carries the watermark text box that an Aspose.Slides save without a license added; a licensed re-save keeps it.
An empty placeholder is invisible in a slide show but shows its prompt text when the deck is edited.
An opaque foreground shape covers at least 80% of a content shape.
A shape extends beyond the slide boundaries.
A slide has no visible authored content.
A slide repeats the meaningful content and geometry of an earlier slide.
Text has a contrast below 3:1 with the solid fill or background behind it, so it is hard to read.
Laid-out text runs past a slide edge, where the slide cuts it off.
Laid-out text spills out of a shape that neither grows to fit it nor shrinks it on overflow.
Laid-out text runs into a table or chart, or an opaque shape in front of it covers the text.
A shape contains visible text smaller than 12 pt.

v2/slides/ops.description: The operation document of slides edit --ops. Every slide and shape target resolves against the presentation as it was before the first operation, so content inserted earlier in the batch cannot be targeted, and a target deleted earlier fails the operation. Operations apply in order. Without --best-effort the batch is atomic: if any operation fails, no file is written. With --best-effort the operations that succeed are kept and saved, each one that fails is reported, and the command exits 8 when any failed; an invalid document or a failure inside the document engine still writes nothing.

ifMatch.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint the input must still have; the edit fails when it changed.

id.description: A correlation id echoed in the result; op-0001 style ids are assigned when omitted.
